question: Under the US Advanced Battery Consortium standard, when does an EV battery reach the end of its usable life, what can be done with such batteries, and which of those does the review say they all eventually need?
rendered:
- An EV battery reaches the end of its usable life when its current cell capacity is less than 80% of the rated capacity.
- Those end-of-life EV batteries can be reused/repurposed, recycled, or disposed in landfills (this latter would cause serious environmental issues).
- Regardless of whether batteries are reused, they will eventually need to be recycled.
